page.overview:
Who is Adelia Ruskin?

Adelia Ruskin was a nineteenth century woman who was murdered by her husband Edward Ruskin. He buried her in Glencourt Manor. Her spirit was bound to the manor and Edward. Over the next century he would return and put new binding spells on her.

As a result she was weakened, her memories were suppressed and she could barely remember who she was. However she gradually became resistant to the spells. Upon regaining her memories she turned into a malevolent spirit.

Deadman and Berenice eventually allowed Adelia to have her revenge by killing Edward, thus allowing her spirit to move on to the afterlife.
